description: Use to discover sheets, used ranges, defined names and the workbook's dateSystem ("1900" or "1904") before choosing inputs and outputs. Dates are serial numbers in the workbook's date system. Names include values up to 100 cells, or range address and dimensions for larger blocks (expression arrays have a null address). Pass sheet for referenced constant or blank inputs and terminal formula outputs. Lists are capped at 100 entries. Above the 20000-byte response budget including both copies, named values are omitted with valuesOmitted: true; discovery lists may be shortened with an explicit message. Static discovery can miss dynamic or structured references.

path.description: Local workbook path (absolute recommended), at most 50 MiB; .xlsx, .xlsm, .xltx or .xltm.

sheet.description: Sheet name for input/output candidate discovery.

name: describe_workbook
